newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: DUTCH SHELL CUTS GASOLINE, DIESEL PRICES.
newsitem.headline: DUTCH SHELL CUTS GASOLINE, DIESEL PRICES.

text.p: Royal Dutch/Shell unit Shell Nederland BV said on Friday it would raise its retail prices for gasoline and diesel in the Netherlands with effect from Tuesday Juli 1.
The move reflects changes in duty on gasoline and diesel in the Netherlands, Shell said.
From Tuesday the price of premium unleaded gasoline at Shell's self-service stations will rise to 2.22 guilders per litre from 2.09.
The price of premium with lead substitute rises to 2.29 guilders from 2.16 and Euro regular unleaded to 2.17 guilders from 2.04 guilders.
The recommended price for diesel goes up to 1.498 guilders per litre from 1.438, Shell said.
